description.narrative:
The aim of the envisaged project is to contribute towards peaceful co-existence among the communities and its environs through community capacity building on conflict resolution and management. Over the years Isiolo has experienced many forms of conflict the year. From the years 1996 – 2002 Isiolo experienced serious forms of conflicts that prompted many actors to intervene with varying degree of success. Since the year 2002 up to 2009 Isiolo experienced a period of peace probably due to the change in the political climate.
Given the Catholic Church position of non partisan, non political and being voice of the voiceless it is better placed to intervene and foster peace in the affected area. The church realizes that issues of peace can not be handled single – handedly. It is in this spirit that the diocese envisages to work with other likeminded people and institutions in this endeavor. The diocese of Isiolo and partners are ideally suited to support this initiative because of their interest in development, human rights and promotion of human dignity and peaceful society.
The project's two main aims include, to promote peaceful and harmonious co-existence among the Isiolo communities and the neighbors; and to enhance communities capacities on peace and conflict transformation.
